# Account Management

Own account: update profile, change password, profile picture (read/upload).

4 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

| PUT | [`/api/identity/account/UpdateProfile`](#op-account-updateprofile) | Account_UpdateProfile |
| PUT | [`/api/identity/account/ChangePassword`](#op-account-changepassword) | Account_ChangePassword |
| GET | [`/api/identity/account/profile-picture/{userId}`](#op-account-getprofilepicture) | Account_GetProfilePicture |

### PUT `/api/identity/account/UpdateProfile`

operationId `Account_UpdateProfile` · Updates the current user's profile information

Parameters: _none_

Request body `model` (application/json), **required**: [UpdateProfileRequest](#schema-updateprofilerequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Result](#schema-result) | Profile updated successfully |
| `400` | [Result](#schema-result) | Invalid request data |

Request model for changing user password

Required: `password`, `newPassword`, `confirmNewPassword`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `password` | string | yes | Gets or sets the current password for verification; minLength 1 |
| `newPassword` | string | yes | Gets or sets the new password to be set; minLength 1 |
| `confirmNewPassword` | string | yes | Gets or sets the confirmation of the new password (must match NewPassword); minLength 1 |
